title: Learn 잠깐만 (“wait a sec”) by singing it 🎵 #learnkorean
caption:
Learn 잠깐만 (jam-kkan-man) the catchy way — it means “wait a sec”.
Casual Korean for friends and family. Polite form: 잠깐만요 (jam-kkan-man-yo).
Clap when the singing stops, then you’re up!

_원문.title: 잠깐만(「잠깐만」), 불러서 배우기 🎵
_원문.caption:
귀에 붙는 방법으로 잠깐만(jam-kkan-man)를 배워 — 「잠깐만」라는 뜻.
친구 · 가족끼리 쓰는 반말. 존댓말: 잠깐만요(jam-kkan-man-yo).
노래가 멈추면 손뼉, 그다음 네 차례!
